name: Valid Company
source:
You, Marissa Clarke, have a plan. 

You plan to put your psychology degree to work and start a research project of your own! With the deadline closing in and only a vague idea that you will be researching something about classical music, you attend the concert of the up-and-coming cellist Alan Dalencourt to survey the scene. You never expected to find yourself pulled into a group with Alan, his brothers, and two of his friends!

[From [url=https://moneabaguettes.itch.io/valid-company]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你，玛丽莎·克拉克，有一个计划。

你计划将你的心理学学位运用到工作中并开始自己的研究项目！随着截止日期的临近，只有一个模糊的想法，你将研究一些关于古典音乐的东西，你参加了崭露头角的大提琴家艾伦·达朗库特的音乐会，以考察现场。你绝对不会想到自己会和艾伦、他的兄弟以及他的两个朋友在一起！
